verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is an e-commerce platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is the MCP-client role, which is outside this product's category. The evidence documents only the opposite role: WooCommerce exposes a native MCP interface so outside AI assistants can act on stores. That is server-side evidence, it does not transfer to this client story, and nothing shows WooCommerce itself connecting to external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
